title: Rickover and the Atomic Energy Commission

tellings.quote: Well, first of all, the Atomic Energy Commission wasn't under Department of Energy till 76

plain: The Atomic Energy Commission, the body that ran America's nuclear work from 1946, was not part of the Department of Energy until 1976, according to John S. Herrington, a former Secretary of Energy, who tells Michels this as a point of record. He brings it up along with Hyman Rickover, the admiral who built the Navy's nuclear-powered fleet, and he credits a document called Underway My Way. It matters to the conversation because it marks which agency held America's nuclear secrets, and when.
